course_name_original: Cálculo y desarrollo de equipos para procesos de fabricación (248404)
course_name_en: Calculation and Development of Equipment for Manufacturing Processes

learning_outcomes.text: Propose projects on equipment for manufacturing processes, including material selection and the technology required for their manufacture.

Acquire knowledge in the development of equipment for manufacturing processes, manufacturing technology, and materials engineering, enabling them to learn new methods and theories, and providing versatility to adapt to new situations.
Express and communicate ideas and systems related to manufacturing systems and processes, as well as materials technology.
Understand and prepare professional technical documentation, in the context of activities related to manufacturing systems and processes, as well as materials technology.
Master manufacturing processes and systems, including metrology and quality evaluation systems used in Engineering.
Master calculations and estimation and design procedures in matters of materials, production, and manufacturing.

syllabus_topics: Calculation and development of material removal forming equipment.
Calculation and development of plastic deformation forming equipment.
Calculation and design of plastic injection molds.
Calculation and design of dies for sheet metal processing.
Calculation and design of dies for volumetric plastic deformation equipment.
Practical examples of dies and casting patterns
assessment_rules: To average the sections, students must achieve a minimum of 4.5 out of 10 points in the exam. If the exam score is 4.5 points or higher, the final grade will be the weighted arithmetic mean of the sections. If the exam score is below 4.5 points and the weighted arithmetic mean is 5.0 points or higher, the final grade will be 4.9 points. If the exam score is below 4.5 points and the weighted arithmetic mean is below 5.0 points, the final grade will be that weighted arithmetic mean. If the student does not attend the exam, the grade will be 'Not presented'.
